name: Show Product Sales Count for WooCommerce
author: WPBean

sections.description:
Show Product Sales Count for WooCommerce lets you easily display how many times each product has been sold on your WooCommerce store. This feature helps build trust and social proof, encouraging more customers to make a purchase.

You can customize where the sales count appears on the single product page directly from the plugin settings. It also includes options to hide the sales number for products with no sales or disable it for specific products when needed.

Simple, lightweight, and fully compatible with any WooCommerce theme — this plugin is the perfect way to add real-time sales insights to your online store.

DEMO | Support

Plugin Features

  • Two different display styles for showing the sales count.
  • Option to change the placement of the sales number on the product page.
  • Option to hide the sales number for products with no sales.
  • Option to disable the sales count display for specific products.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Compatible with all standard WordPress and WooCommerce themes.
  • Easy to use with a simple settings interface.
  • Clean, well-structured code — easy to customize for developers.

You may also like our some other WooCommerce plugins

sections.installation:
• Install it as a regular WordPress plugin

  • Active the plugin.

  • This plugin’s will show the sale number in your single product page.

  • Go to this plugin’s setting panel for customize.
sections.faq:
How to change the placement of the sale number?

Go to this plugin setting page, where you will see a dropdown for selecting the placement.

How can I change the font-size & color of WPB Show Product Sales Number for WooCommerce?

Go to this plugin setting page, under style settings, you will see the color picker and font size settings.
